description: Show this MCP's local device identity, pairing status, current scopes (if any), and any pending pairing requestId. Triggers a fresh connect attempt, so it doubles as a 'retry pairing' command after approval. Use when scoped methods fail with 'missing scope: operator.read'.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

name: openclaw_device_status
